card.name: Words leading up to admission or appointment
card.fires_on: Small verbs and linking words (be, for, was, appointed, also) in biographical or historical text, just before a word about being admitted, appointed or elected to a post or institution.

modes.label: Before appointment
modes.description: Verb or helper word right before being appointed to a post.
modes.example: with such success as to<< be>> appointed lecturer there, Domenico Cap

modes.label: Before admission
modes.description: Word before admission or being admitted to a school or academy.
modes.example: He applied twice unsuccessfully<< for>> admission to the Vienna Academy of Fine Arts

modes.label: Other list or rule wording
modes.description: Helper words before a predicted verb or term in lists or formal rules.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like admission, admit and met as the next word.
card.plain: It lights up on small words that come just before someone is admitted, appointed or made a member.
